mapper.select: SELECT * FROM godp_auto_planning_task WHERE del_flag='N' AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM godp_auto_planning_task WHERE del_flag='N' AND cycle_start=#{cycleStart}
SELECT * FROM godp_auto_planning_task WHERE del_flag='N' AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM godp_auto_planning_task WHERE del_flag='N' AND status IN ('待发起','计算中','待确认') ORDER BY updated_at,id LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE godp_auto_planning_task SET status=#{status},pipeline_id=#{pipelineId},legacy_batch_id=#{legacyBatchId},attempts=attempts+1,last_error='',updated_at=#{time},updated_by=#{auditActor} WHERE del_flag='N' AND id=#{id} AND status='待发起'
UPDATE godp_auto_planning_task SET attempts=attempts+1,last_error=#{error},updated_at=#{time},updated_by=#{auditActor} WHERE del_flag='N' AND id=#{id} AND status='待发起'
UPDATE godp_auto_planning_task SET status=#{status},legacy_batch_id=#{legacyBatchId},last_error=#{error},updated_at=#{time},updated_by=#{auditActor} WHERE del_flag='N' AND id=#{id} AND status='计算中'

UPDATE godp_auto_planning_task SET status='待确认',business_batch_id=#{batchId},proposal_hash=#{hash},last_error='',updated_at=#{time},updated_by=#{auditActor} WHERE del_flag='N' AND id=#{id} AND status='计算中' AND business_batch_id IS NULL

UPDATE godp_auto_planning_task SET status='已完成',confirmation_attempts=confirmation_attempts+1,last_error='',updated_at=#{time},updated_by=#{auditActor} WHERE del_flag='N' AND id=#{id} AND status='待确认' AND business_batch_id=#{batchId} AND proposal_hash=#{hash}

UPDATE godp_auto_planning_task SET last_error=#{error},confirmation_attempts=confirmation_attempts+CASE WHEN status='待确认' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,updated_at=#{time},updated_by=#{auditActor} WHERE del_flag='N' AND id=#{id} AND status IN ('计算中','待确认')
